title: Bolt
bio: Estonian mobility app for rides, scooters and food delivery in Europe and Africa.

title: Brainly
bio: Online learning community based in Poland where students ask homework questions and get answers from peers, experts and AI tools.

title: Brex
bio: Brex offers corporate cards, business accounts and spend management software for startups and growing companies.

title: BrighterMonday
bio: BrighterMonday is an online job site in Kenya where employers advertise vacancies and job seekers search for work.

title: Brilliant
bio: American online learning platform offering interactive lessons and problem-solving courses in mathematics, science, data and computer science.

title: Checkout.com
bio: Checkout.com is a payment processing company that helps online businesses accept card and alternative payments in multiple currencies.

title: Chobani
bio: American food company making Greek yogurt, oat milk, coffee creamers and ready-to-drink coffee products.

title: ClassDojo
bio: American school communication app that connects teachers, students and parents to share classroom updates, messages and student progress.

title: Cleartrip
bio: Indian online travel agency for booking flights, hotels and buses, owned by Flipkart.

title: Codecademy
bio: American online platform offering interactive courses in programming languages, web development and data science that run in the browser.

title: Coinone
bio: Coinone is a South Korean cryptocurrency exchange where users can buy, sell and trade digital assets with Korean won.

title: CoinSpot
bio: CoinSpot is an Australian cryptocurrency exchange where users can buy, sell and swap a wide range of digital assets.

title: Course Hero
bio: American online study platform where students access course-specific study guides, practice problems and documents shared by other learners.

title: CRED
bio: CRED is an Indian app that lets members pay credit card bills, rent and utilities and access rewards and credit products.

title: Crypto.com
bio: Crypto trading app with a debit card and exchange.

title: Cuemath
bio: Cuemath is an Indian education company offering live online maths tutoring for school-age children in India and other countries.
